name: Amina Adebayo
headline: 18-year-old apprentice carpenter in Lagos
description: Amina lives in a rented room in Mushin and wakes at 5 a.m. to sweep a building site for 500 naira, then attends a vocational carpentry course in the afternoon. She carries a worn notebook for every expense and keeps her few tools locked in a metal box, always double-checking her measurements before cutting.
